message: well i see you all our very upset with tnetix and i have read most of this and im sorry for any and all complaints against this company however you and everbody else have no right to take it out on the representative..any and all questions u have are answered when u ask..if the rep doesn't know then they get you the answer...i feel this is so unfair if u would give the representatives to explain anything you may understand pvps also known as payment verif. points or spending limits it is all done for your security and asking for a ssn is always for security however if you ask there is cases where that is not needed passcodes and such are taken aswell..and the blocks not always are fault..certain facilties have what are called site limits just please next time you go to call tnetix, cbs, securus, whatever they are called now..just think about the person your calling you dont know if there going trhough the same thing u are right now they are humans too they might have a loved one in jail just as you do...
